mechanical: Vertical flat metal shaft, L1=15 mm; diameter 6 mm with drawing tolerances, flat dimension 4.5 mm.
M9×0.75 bushing; LB=5 mm; flat length l1=7 mm.
Drawing body width 12.1 mm; mounting-side hole drawing has three 1 mm electrical holes across a 5 mm span and 11.3 mm support spacing.
300° ±5° rotation, no detent; drawing shows full CCW shaft position.
soldering: Manufacturer product page: dip 260±5 °C max, 5±1 s, max 2 passes; preheat underside 100 °C max, 2 min.
Hand solder reference 350 °C max, 3 s, once; factory process must be agreed.
source: Exact product-page dimensional GIF and official RK09L catalog drawing 3.
